attempts.text:
**The window starts on the `ssu` genes.** Column 0, `ssuA`, is spine: carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, named in 99%. Columns 1 to 3, `ssuD`, `ssuC` and `ssuB`, are variable, carried by 89 to 90%, and the model names 98 to 99% there.

**A run of short spines follows.** Columns 4 to 6, `pepN`, `pncB` and `asnS`, are spine at 90 to 91%, named 95 to 99%, and columns 8 to 10, `aspC`, `gloC` and `mepK`, are spine at 90 to 91%, named 99 to 99.8%. The variable columns between them, `ompF` and `ldtD`, are named 97 to 99%. Then columns 12 to 19, `mukB` to `ycaR`, are spine at 90 to 91%: the model names only 57% at `mukF`, but no column there hesitates more than 0.15 bits.

**The middle spines are read easily.** Columns 21 to 22, `lpxK` and `msbA`, are spine at 90 to 91%, named 99 to 99.6%, with no column above 0.06 bits; columns 24 to 26, `ihfB`, `rpsA` and `cmk`, are spine at 90%, named 97 to 99.6%. Columns 28 to 29, `aroA` and `serC`, and columns 31 to 32, `ycaO` and `focA`, are spine at 90%, named 97 to 99%. The variable columns 20, 23, 27 and 30 sit between them, named 92 to 99%.

**The long variable tail is where the model hesitates.** Columns 33 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 11 to 25% of calls, named 62 to 98%, fewest at column 76, 62%. The most hesitant column is 65, `poxB`, 0.77 bits. Column 60 is a fork: `ybjD` persistent at 74%, with an IS1-like element transposase shell at 12%. Column 79 is a fork: `potI` persistent at 57%, with `potH` at 30% and `potG` at 14%.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model is less sure.** Across the window it names 92% of genes at 0.32 bits; inside a region of plasticity it names 65% against 95% outside, and hesitates 1.71 against 0.14 bits. Persistent calls are named 96% at 0.12 bits, shell 72% at 1.20 bits, cloud 19% at 4.25 bits. The window ends at column 79, `potI`, carried by 57% of chromosomes.

label: ssuA
facts:
WINDOW: the ssuA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ssuA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,761 to 2,840 from dnaA. Read in 525 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ssuA once); 42,000 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.32 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,145 calls, named 96%, 0.12 bits; shell 5,154 calls, named 72%, 1.20 bits; cloud 701 calls, named 19%, 4.25 bits. Outside an RGP 37,139 calls, named 95%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 4,861 calls, named 65%, 1.71 bits. Columns: 24 spine, 2 fork, 54 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.71 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (65% against 95%); 4,861 of the 42,000 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 65 (poxB) 0.77 bits, RGP 21%; column 35 (ycaK) 0.73 bits, RGP 13%; column 53 (clpA) 0.73 bits, RGP 25%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 33-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 11-25%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ssuA. named 99%; 0.13 bits.
2. columns 1-3 (3 columns) variable: RGP 0.2-9%. named 98-99% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 3, named 98%; most hesitant at column 2, 0.36 bits.
   1: ssuD P 90%
   2: ssuC P 90% "aliphatic sulfonate ABC transporter…"
   3: ssuB P 89%
3. columns 4-6 (3 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 9%. Genes: pepN, pncB, asnS. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (pepN), named 95%, 0.20 bits.
4. column 7 variable: RGP 8%. named 97%; 0.47 bits.
   7: ompF P 88%
5. columns 8-10 (3 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 0.2-7%. Genes: aspC, gloC, mepK. named 99-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 9 (gloC), named 99%; most hesitant at column 8 (aspC), 0.24 bits.
6. column 11 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 99%; 0.12 bits.
   11: ldtD P 90%
7. columns 12-19 (8 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: mukB "chromosome partition protein MukB", mukE, mukF, cmoM, elyC, ycbJ "YcbJ family phosphotransferase", kdsB, ycaR "protein YcaR". named 57-99.8% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 14 (mukF), named 57%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.15 bits (column 12 (mukB)).
8. column 20 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 98%; 0.14 bits.
   20: ycaQ P 88% "crosslink repair DNA glycosylase Yc…"
9. columns 21-22 (2 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: lpxK, msbA. named 99-99.6% (mean 99.5%), fewest named at column 21 (lpxK), named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.06 bits (column 22 (msbA)).
10. column 23 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 92%; 0.39 bits.
   23: ycaI P 82% "DNA internalization-related compete…"
11. columns 24-26 (3 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 0.4%. Genes: ihfB, rpsA, cmk. named 97-99.6% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 24 (ihfB), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.13 bits (column 24 (ihfB)).
12. column 27 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 98%; 0.08 bits.
   27: ycaL P 89%
13. columns 28-29 (2 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 1%. Genes: aroA, serC. named 97-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 28 (aroA), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.12 bits (column 28 (aroA)).
14. column 30 variable: RGP 1%. named 99%; 0.16 bits.
   30: ycaP P 89% "DUF421 domain-containing protein"
15. columns 31-32 (2 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 1-3%. Genes: ycaO "YcaO-like family protein", focA. named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 31 (ycaO)).
16. columns 33-79 (47 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 11-25%. named 62-98% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 76, named 62%; most hesitant at column 65, 0.77 bits.
   columns 33-59 variable, share 49-90%, 24 P, 3 S: pflB 90%, pflA "pyruvate formate lyase 1-activating…" 90%, ycaK 49%, ycaN "LysR substrate-binding domain-conta…" 56%, ycaM "amino acid permease" 74%, ycaD "MFS transporter" 85%, ycaC 83%, dmsC "dimethyl sulfoxide reductase anchor…" 84%, dmsB 83%, dmsA 81%, serS 80%, rarA 80%, lolA 80%, ftsK 79%, lrp 79%, trxB 79%, cydD 79%, cydC "heme ABC transporter ATP-binding pr…" 79%, aat 79%, infA 79%, clpA 74%, clpS "ATP-dependent Clp protease adapter…" 74%, yljB "protein YljB" 74%, cspD 74%, macB "ABC transporter permease" 73%, macA 74%, ybjX "VirK/YbjX family protein" 73%
   60 fork: ybjD P 74% "ATP-dependent endonuclease"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 12%
   columns 61-78 variable, share 63-73%, all P: aqpZ 70%, lysO 73%, hcp 73%, hcr 73%, poxB 72%, ltaE 72%, ybjT "NAD(P)H-binding protein" 71%, ybjS "NAD(P)-dependent oxidoreductase" 71%, amiD 70%, ybjQ "heavy metal-binding domain-containi…" 70%, ybjP "lipoprotein" 70%, artP 71%, artI "arginine ABC transporter substrate-…" 70%, artQ 70%, artM 70%, artJ 69%, rlmC 65%, ybjO "YbjO family protein" 63%
